title: Critical minerals for the global energy transition
description: Tanzania holds graphite, lithium, uranium and rare earths — increasingly valuable in global energy and tech; value addition is prioritised over raw export.

title: Power generation & clean energy
description: Electricity per person must rise from ~170 to 3,000 kWh; investment is sought in hydro, solar, wind, geothermal and nuclear.

title: From raw materials to finished goods
description: Manufacturing (8.1% of GDP, growing ~8%/yr) is set to expand via agro-processing, construction materials and import substitution.

title: Regional trade hub & AfCFTA access
description: Upgraded railways, ports and roads aim to make Tanzania a gateway for East and Southern Africa — a base for regional exports.

title: Digital services & fintech
description: Targets of 70% digital literacy and 80% of government services online create demand for platforms, fintech and integrations.

title: Agri-tech and cold-chain
description: Agriculture (26.5% of GDP, 65% of jobs) is to modernise via digitalisation, aquaculture and cold-chain logistics.

title: R&D financing and IP commercialisation
description: A commitment of at least 1% of GDP to R&D, with IP protection and centres of excellence, opens grants and spin-outs.

title: Public-private partnerships for infrastructure
description: The plan leans on PPPs to reduce aid dependency and finance infrastructure and services.

title: Jobs in tourism and hospitality
description: Tourism (25% of export earnings) is set to become a leading source of direct and indirect jobs across hospitality and transport.

title: Blue economy — LNG, fisheries, coastal tourism
description: An extensive coastline and lakes are largely untapped for fisheries, marine transport, LNG and ocean energy.

title: Skills, M&E and institutional strengthening
description: A low Human Capital Index (0.39) and skills mismatches create demand for training, M&E and institutional capacity.

title: Data centres, AI and cybersecurity
description: Investment in data infrastructure, AI, GIS and secure systems underpins the digital-government agenda.

title: Deepening credit and capital markets
description: A narrow tax base (11.9% tax-to-GDP) and financing gaps mean demand for project finance, SME lending and capital markets.

title: Creative & sports industries
description: Music, film, fashion and sport are flagged as untapped sectors for youth employment and cultural export.
